subject: FinTrust SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist: implementation liaison & next steps
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice.park@fintrust.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintrust.com, jim.lopez@fintrust.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTrust access controls kick-off

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. A couple of clarifying items from our security team so we can align the runbook: 

- We need a SCIM spec that maps our AD groups to Redwood roles (admin, app_user, auditor). Do you have an example mapping?
- Is the SSO metadata endpoint signed or do we upload a static XML? Our IdP team prefers SAML metadata URL endpoints.
- For IP allowlisting: can Redwood accept a per-environment CIDR block for prod and staging? We operate from a set of AWS NAT gateways and a small on-prem office range.
- Service accounts: we want to create two read-only service accounts for telemetry and logs ingestion. What permissions do those require?

I've attached the SOC2 evidence bundle and our internal checklist. Can you propose a technical liaison from your side who will own the implementation sequence with our engineers?

Regards,
Alice Park
Head of IT Security — FinTrust Financial
attachments: fintrust-soc2-evidence.zip
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@fintrust.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTrust access controls kick-off

Alice — thanks for the details and the SOC2 bundle. Happy to own the liaison role for the kickoff and sequencing. I summarized next steps below and attached a lightweight SCIM/SAML template that should speed us up.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Review SCIM mapping template (attached: sso-config-template.csv) — please confirm AD group names and any custom attributes we should pull.
2) SAML metadata: Redwood supports both static XML upload and metadata URL. We recommend metadata URL for automatic cert rotation; if your IdP cannot host a URL we can accept signed XML.
3) IP allowlist: we can accept CIDR blocks per environment. For long-lived NAT CIDRs we will add them to the tenant allowlist; for ephemeral bursts we recommend using our VPN-based jump host (we can add those pub keys).
4) Service accounts: we will create two scoped API keys with the following roles: logs.readonly and metrics.ingest. Keys are stored in our customer KMS and rotatable on a 90-day cadence.

Can we schedule a 30-minute technical session this week (Wed/Thu) with your IdP and network engineer to finalize the SCIM mapping and IP ranges?

Thanks — I attached the SCIM/SAML template and a mutual action plan link.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
attachments: sso-config-template.csv; mutual-action-plan-v1.docx
From: Jim Lopez <jim.lopez@fintrust.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Park <alice.park@fintrust.com>, security@fintrust.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTrust access controls kick-off

Thanks Kimberly — I'm FinTrust's network lead. A few specifics from our infra side: 

- Prod NAT CIDRs: 18.204.0.0/18, 35.172.192.0/20
- Staging CIDRs: 34.210.128.0/20
- Office on-prem range: 203.0.113.0/24

Two notes:
- We have a policy that any third-party service that can push data to our VPC must use service accounts with least privilege and MFA-enabled rotation where possible. How does Redwood handle MFA for service account API keys?
- For SCIM, our IdP is Okta and they prefer group filter rules rather than full sync initially. We can provide the group names if you confirm the schema.

I'll join the technical session tomorrow at 10:30 PT.

—Jim
Network Engineering — FinTrust
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@fintrust.com>, Jim Lopez <jim.lopez@fintrust.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTrust access controls kick-off

Great sync yesterday — quick implementation notes and owner assignments following the call: 

- SCIM mapping: Jordan will create the mapping in a temp tenant and share a test SCIM endpoint for FinTrust to validate. (Owner: jordan_blake)
- SAML metadata: Kimberly will coordinate metadata URL or signed XML and work with Alice to confirm cert rotation policy. (Owner: kimberly_park)
- IP allowlist: Ben will add the provided CIDRs to a staging allowlist and create a change window plan for prod cutover. Ben will also document rollback steps. (Owner: ben_carter)
- Service accounts: I will generate the two least-privileged API keys in the staging tenant, record provisioning steps in the mutual action plan, and confirm KMS rotation settings and any MFA/rotation workaround for non-interactive accounts. (Owner: marissa_cole)

Deliverables and timeline:
- Temp SCIM endpoint + mapping CSV by 2027-05-18
- SAML metadata verification + test SSO by 2027-05-20
- Staging IP allowlist configured and smoke-tested by 2027-05-21
- Service account keys provisioned in staging + manual rotation runbook by 2027-05-22

Questions for FinTrust:
- Please confirm the AD group names to map (security, app_users, auditors) or send the Okta group filters.
- Confirm whether service account keys should be delivered via shared secure vault (we can push to your HashiCorp Vault path if you provide access) or uploaded to a S3 staging bucket with short-lived presigned URLs.

I'll update the mutual action plan with these milestones and ping when each deliverable is ready for validation. Short, focused change windows will keep risk low.

Thanks all — looking forward to the cutover.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference
